generated_note: PDFE harness-adversarial-audit Phase-2 (HOSTILE-INPUT COVERAGE MATRIX). Generated 2026-07-28 by enumerating tests/fixtures/ (incl. adversarial_ambient/, flaw_corpus/, realworld/) and grepping tests/*.cpp for consumers that FEED each hostile-input class to a real product path AND assert. Method = Equivalence-Partitioning / Boundary-Value-Analysis / FMEA. A class is 'nonzero' only when at least one test drives the hostile input through a product path (open/render/extract/edit/save/sign/redact/permissions/JS) and makes an assertion; 'partial' = fixture exists but no asserting consumer, OR only one product path covered while sibling paths are blind; 'zero' = no fixture or no consumer. FIND-AND-DOCUMENT only; no product/test code changed.
